learning_outcomes.text: Use programming languages, databases, and computer programs for engineering applications.
Recognize and understand programming languages, operating systems, databases, and computer programs applied to engineering.
Recognize and understand the training needs that will be useful to successfully resolve new situations related to industrial engineering.
Propose creative solutions to satisfactorily respond to real needs and problems of society.
Apply industrial engineering knowledge in learning new methods and theories.

syllabus_topics: Programming Practices: Algorithm and program development related to engineering. Databases: Information management. Basic concepts.
Operating Systems: Introduction to Operating Systems. Linux Operating System: Shell Practices.
C Programming I: Structure of a C program. Variables. Operations. Decision structures. Loops. Basic I/O. Arrays. Matrices. Functions. Character strings.
Algorithms: Variables and Constants. Linear Sequence. Selection. Loops. Basic data structures.
Principles of Computer Architecture: Introduction to computers. Historical evolution. Basic hardware components. Von Neumann model. Bus interconnection model.
C Programming II - Memory and Storage Management: Static and dynamic memory. Stack and Heap. Pass by value and by reference. Pointers. Files.
